en: Fine, fine. It's up to you.
cz: Dobre, dobre. Je to na tobe.

en:
Excellent, excellent. He's at my
home right now. Thank you SO much.
cz:
Vyborne, vyborne. Je ted u me
doma. MOC ti dekuji.

en:
Allow me to mark the location of my
home here on your map.
cz:
Dovol mi oznacit polohu meho
domova na tve mape.

en:
Bring whatever piece you like.

The shape you like is simply
a matter of personal taste, goro!
cz:
Prines jakykoli kousek chces.

Tvar je jen otazkou
osobniho vkusu, goro!

en: All gone! Come again.
cz: Vse pryc! Prijd zase.

en:
Yes, Kinstones!
Each one is different, goro!
This Kinstone costs {Var:1} Rupees. 
 {Choice:FF}Buy {Choice:2C:1D}Don't buy
cz:
Ano, Kameny osudu!
Kazdy je jiny, goro!
Tento Kamen stoji {Var:1} rupii. 
 {Choice:FF}Koupit {Choice:2C:1D}Nekoupit

en:
No deal? Goro! Too bad! But come
again. I will always have good pieces!
cz:
Nic? Goro! Skoda! Ale prijd
zase. Vzdy budu mit dobre kousky!

en:
You don't have enough Rupees...
Come back with more money, goro.
cz:
Nemas dost rupii...
Vrat se s vetsi castkou, goro.

en:
You have too many pieces! I can't
sell you any until you make room!
cz:
Mas prilis mnoho kousku! Nemohu
ti dalsi prodat, dokud neudelas misto!

en:
Thank you, goro. Come back anytime
and buy the rest!
cz:
Dekuji, goro. Prijd kdykoli
a koup si zbytek!

en:
No more, no more, but come back
again. I promise to find more, goro!
cz:
Uz nic, uz nic, ale vrat se
zase. Slibuji, ze najdu dalsi, goro!

en:
I believe there should be a {Color:Blue}doggie
dish{Color:White} for my dog back at my house.
Just face the {Color:Blue}dish{Color:White} and press {Key:Right} to
dump the food into little Fifi's bowl.
cz:
U me doma by mela byt {Color:Blue}psi
miska{Color:White} pro meho psa.
Postav se k {Color:Blue}misce{Color:White} a stiskni {Key:Right}
pro nasypani zradla male Fifi.

en:
{Sound:00:D1}My master, {Color:Green}Stockwell{Color:White}, has been coming
home far too late to play with me...
I'm so lonely.
cz:
{Sound:00:D1}Muj pan, {Color:Green}Stockwell{Color:White}, chodi domu
prilis pozde, abychom si hrali...
Jsem tak sam.

Care for some of Granny's

One sip, and you're full of energy!
Please, look around...

Das si trochu babiccinho

Jeden douseks a jsi plny energie!
Prosim, podivej se kolem...

en:
That's Granny's homemade

I'll fill your bottle for 60 Rupees.
What do you say?

en:
Ever heard of Granny's
homemade {Color:Red}blue potion{Color:White}?
One sip, and you're full of energy!

Fill a {Color:Red}bottle {Color:White}and carry it around with
you! After all, it's only 60 Rupees!
Will you buy some?
{07:2D:00}
cz:
Slysel jsi o babiccine
domacim {Color:Red}modrem lektvaru{Color:White}?
Jeden douseks a jsi plny energie!

Naplnis si {Color:Red}lahev{Color:White} a nosis ji s sebou!
Koneckoncu, jen 60 rupii!
Koupis si?

en:
Granny's stuff is the best! This is my
traditional {Color:Red}red potion{Color:White}!
Shall I fill your {Color:Red}bottle{Color:White} for...
150 Rupees? What do you say?
{07:2D:00}
cz:
Babiccino zbozi je nejlepsi! Toto
je muj tradicni {Color:Red}cerveny lektvar{Color:White}!
Mam ti naplnit {Color:Red}lahev{Color:White} za...
150 rupii? Co ty na to?
{07:2D:00}

en:
Once you've tried my new {Color:Red}red potion{Color:White},
you'll never go back to the {Color:Red}blue{Color:White} stuff!
Shall I fill your {Color:Red}bottle {Color:White}for 150 Rupees?
What do you say, my pretty young boy?
{07:2D:00}
cz:
Jakmile ochutnas muj novy {Color:Red}cerveny
lektvar{Color:White}, na {Color:Red}modry{Color:White} uz nikdy nesahnes!
Mam ti naplnit {Color:Red}lahev{Color:White} za 150 rupii?
Co ty na to, muj hezky mladiku?
{07:2D:00}

en:
Come back when you need more...
Hehehehe!
cz:
Vrat se, kdyz budes potrebovat
vic... Hehehehe!

en:
Ah, yes! A fine choice, my dear!
That's a limited-time article!
One whiff, and you're wide-awake! That
is why it's called a {Color:Red}wake-up mushroom{Color:White}!
Would you like to buy it for 60 Rupees?
{Choice:FF}Buy {Choice:FF}Don't buy
cz:
Ach ano! Skvela volba, milacku!
To je limitovany kousek!
Jeden cuch a jsi vzhuru! Proto
se mu rika {Color:Red}probouzeci houba{Color:White}!
Chces ji koupit za 60 rupii?

en:
You've got an eye for fine goods!

That, my dear, is my highly regarded,
homemade {Color:Red}blue potion{Color:White}!
cz:
Mas oko pro kvalitni zbozi!

To, milacku, je muj velmi cenny
domaci {Color:Red}modry lektvar{Color:White}!

en:
Ahh, welcome.

Back for Granny's famous {Color:Red}red{Color:White}
and {Color:Red}blue potions{Color:White}?
One sip, and you're full of energy!
Which do you like, deary, red or blue?
cz:
Ach, vitej.

Zpet pro babiccin slavny {Color:Red}cerveny{Color:White}
a {Color:Red}modry lektvar{Color:White}?
Jeden douseks a jsi plny energie!
Ktery chces, miloucky, cerveny nebo modry?

en:
None for you? Well, remember that when
you run out of pep later! Hehehehe!
cz:
Nic pro tebe? Vzpomen si na to,
az ti dojdou sily! Hehehehe!

en:
I can't sell it to you!
You don't have enough Rupees!
Come back when you've got the money!
My potions are always waiting!
Hehehehe!
cz:
Nemohu ti to prodat!
Nemas dost rupii!
Vrat se, az budes mit penize!
Me lektvary vzdycky cekaji!
Hehehehe!

en:
You {Color:Blue}don't have an empty bottle{Color:White} that I
can fill with medicine!
Come back with an {Color:Red}empty bottle{Color:White}!
cz:
{Color:Blue}Nemas prazdnou lahev{Color:White}, kterou
bych naplnila lekem!
Vrat se s {Color:Red}prazdnou lahvi{Color:White}!

en:
Heheheh... Just face the sleepy
snoozer and press {Key:Right}...
That'll pop his eyes right open!
POP!
cz:
Heheheh... Postav se k tomu
ospalci a stiskni {Key:Right}...
Otevre mu to oci hned!
BUM!

en:
In my youth, I was called {Color:Green}Gregal the
Great{Color:White}! I was even a little famous...
But lately my limbs have grown heavy,
and I can't even stand up...
cz:
Za mlada mi rikali {Color:Green}Gregal
Veliky{Color:White}! Byl jsem i trochu slavny...
Ale ted mam tezke udy a
ani se nemuzu postavit...

en:
Goodness! We rarely get visitors here.
Tell me, how did you get here?
cz:
Bozinku! Tady malokdy nekdo prijde.
Povez, jak ses sem dostal?

en:
I can't believe {Color:Green}old Gregal{Color:White} is sick.
He was looking so healthy.
I guess something just took
hold of him...
cz:
Nemuzu uverit, ze {Color:Green}stary Gregal{Color:White}
je nemocny. Vypadal tak zdrave.
Asi se ho neco
zmocnilo...

en:
Nobody believes me, but I saw a ghost
that has taken hold of Granddad!
cz:
Nikdo mi neveri, ale videla jsem
ducha, co se zmocnil dedy!

en:
Once, my grandfather used something
called a {Color:Red}Gust Jar{Color:White} to fight monsters...
He was a miiiighty hero, they say.
But now he's sick in bed...
cz:
Kdysi muj dedecek pouzival neco
zvane {Color:Red}vetrny dzban{Color:White} proti monstrum...
Byl prymocnym hrdinou, rikaji.
Ale ted lezi nemocny...

en:
What? An evil spirit had taken hold of
me? And you drove it away?
You... You might be right!... I can
already feel my energy returning!
I'll be able to get out of bed soon!
What's your name? ...{Player}?
Thank you, my boy. You saved me.
cz:
Cze? Zly duch se me zmocnil?
A tys ho zahnal?
Mozna... mas pravdu!... Uz citim,
jak se mi vraci energie!
Brzy budu moct vstat z postele!
Jak se jmenujes? ...{Player}?
Dekuji, hochu. Zachranil jsi me.

en:
If you're in the area, come by for
a quick visit!
cz:
Az budes v okoli, stav se
na kratkou navstevu!

en:
If you find yourself in the area again,
drop by and see us.
cz:
Az tu zase budes, stav se
a podivej se na nas.

en:
Well, well, well!

Look at how the color has come back to
his face! How can I ever thank you?
I still have a hard time believing he'd
been possessed by a monster, though.
cz:
No, no, no!

Podivej, jak se mu vratila barva
do tvare! Jak ti mohu podekovat?
Porad jen tezko verim, ze ho
posedlo nejake monstrum.

en:
Welcome, welcome. Long, long ago, and
then an age before that...
Our tribe abandoned the place you call
the {Color:Green}Wind Ruins{Color:White}...
With our magic, we moved our palace up
into the skies. We are the {Color:Green}Wind Tribe{Color:White}.
We have been watching, and we know all
that happens on your surface world.
We know a small boy collects {Color:Red}elements
{Color:White}to lift the curse from a princess.{Color:Red}
{Color:White}We know of {Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}and his evil acts...
The winds tell us these things.{Color:Green}
{Color:White}The {Color:Red}Wind Element{Color:White} that you seek lies
deep in the {Color:Green}Palace of Winds {Color:White}above me.
{Color:Blue}When the blade has been infused with
the four elements, the way to the
light force shall open.{Color:White} So it is told
in the legends of the Wind Tribe.
Vaati himself may already know this.

Surface dwellers are not permitted to
enter our palace, but you are special.
You may continue to the roof.
cz:
Vitej, vitej. Pred dlouhou dobou
a jeste daleko predtim...
Nas kmen opustil misto, kteremu
rikate {Color:Green}Vetrne ruiny{Color:White}...
Svou magii jsme presunuli palac
na nebe. Jsme {Color:Green}Kmen vetru{Color:White}.
Sledovali jsme a vime vse, co se
deje na vasem povrchovem svete.
Vime, ze maly chlapec sbira {Color:Red}elementy
{Color:White}k zrucseni kletby princezny.{Color:Red}
{Color:White}Vime o {Color:Green}Vaatim {Color:White}a jeho zlych skutcich...
Vetry nam to vse rikaji.{Color:Green}
{Color:White}{Color:Red}Element vetru{Color:White}, co hledas, lezi
hluboko v {Color:Green}Palaci vetru {Color:White}nade mnou.
{Color:Blue}Kdyz cepel pohlti vsechny ctyri
elementy, otevre se cesta
ke svetelne sile.{Color:White} Tak praji
legendy Kmene vetru.
Sam Vaati to mozna uz vi.

Obyvatele povrchu nesmi vstoupit
do naseho palace, ale ty jsi vyjimecny.
Muzes pokracovat na strechu.

en:
There is a {Color:Blue}tornado {Color:White}atop this house.
Enter it to go to the {Color:Green}Palace of Winds{Color:White}.
Revive the sacred blade and
rescue the princess quickly.
cz:
Na vrcholu domu je {Color:Blue}tornado{Color:White}.
Vstup do nej a dostanes se do
{Color:Green}Palace vetru{Color:White}. Ozij posvatnou cepel
a rychle zachran princeznu.

en:
Oh, it's {Player}!
Thank you for your help earlier!
I've got something else good for you,
so here, please take it!
cz:
Ach, to je {Player}!
Diky za pomoc predtim!
Mam pro tebe jeste neco dobreho,
tak prosim, vezmi si to!

en:
Ohh, if it isn't old {Player}!

My quest to match Kinstones has taken
me all the way up here.
I'm not sure you've noticed yet, but
we're on top of the clouds!
The Wind Tribe lives here!

They protect the path to the {Color:Green}Palace
of Winds{Color:White}, where the {Color:Red}Wind Element{Color:White} lies!
cz:
Ach, jestli to neni stary {Player}!

Ma cesta za parovanim Kamenu osudu
me zavedla az sem nahoru.
Nevim, jestli sis vsiml, ale
jsme nad mraky!
Tady zije Kmen vetru!

Chrani cestu do {Color:Green}Palace
vetru{Color:White}, kde lezi {Color:Red}Element vetru{Color:White}!

en:
Well, well, well!
{Player}!
Thanks for helping! Because of you, my
gramps is all better now!
cz:
No, no, no!
{Player}!
Diky za pomoc! Diky tobe je
muj deda zase v poradku!

en:
We of the Wind Tribe are very skilled
at finding {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}. 
So skilled in fact, that we have more of
them than we can manage!
We can't even store them all. I wish
someone would take a few from us.
cz:
My z Kmene vetru jsme zdatni
v hledani {Color:Red}Kamenu osudu{Color:White}. 
Tak zdatni, ze jich mame vic,
nez zvladame!
Nemuzeme je ani vsechny ulozit.
Chteli bychom, aby si je nekdo vzal.

en:
Oh, it's you!

I thought I'd never make it back here,
but thanks to your Kinstone, I did!
If you're looking for something, go talk
to the elderly woman on the 4th floor.
The winds carry all sort of valuable
information to her.
cz:
Ach, to jsi ty!

Myslel jsem, ze se sem nikdy
nedostanu, ale diky tvemu Kameni jo!
Kdyz neco hledas, pohovor si
se starou zenou ve 4. patre.
Vetry ji prinaseji vsechny mozne
cenne informace.

en:
There is a device in the {Color:Green}palace {Color:White}that
allows one to fly in the sky.
When I get bigger, I want to explore
the {Color:Green}palace {Color:White}and find it...
But I'm too scared right now!
cz:
V {Color:Green}palaci {Color:White}je zarizeni, ktere
umoznuje letat nebem.
Az budu vetsi, chci prozkoumat
{Color:Green}palac {Color:White}a najit ho...
Ale ted se moc boji!

en:
Up on the roof, there's a huge whirlwind
that can take you up to the {Color:Green}palace{Color:White}.
cz:
Nahore na strese je obrovska
smrst, co te zvedne do {Color:Green}palace{Color:White}.

en:
In this tower dwell the people of the
Wind Tribe.
We left your surface world long ago to
serve a greater duty.
We now protect the gate to the {Color:Green}Palace
of Winds{Color:White}, where the {Color:Red}Wind Element{Color:White} lies.
cz:
V teto vezi prebyva Kmen vetru.

Davno jsme opustili tvuj svet
kvuli vyssimu poslani.
Ted strezime branu do {Color:Green}Palace
vetru{Color:White}, kde lezi {Color:Red}Element vetru{Color:White}.

en:
Although we are of the Wind Tribe, we,
too, once lived on the surface.
Once, the place you call the {Color:Green}Wind Ruins{Color:White}
was, to us, a home.
cz:
Ackoli jsme z Kmene vetru, i my
jsme kdysi zili na povrchu.
Misto, kteremu rikate {Color:Green}Vetrne ruiny{Color:White},
bylo pro nas domovem.

en:
Wahh! You surprised me!

Normally, surface dwellers can't walk
on the clouds like we do!
My sister and I went to the {Color:Blue}Picori
Festival{Color:White} in Hyrule Town,
and when we came back, there
were monsters everywhere!
I bet if I could just fuse a {Color:Red}Kinstone{Color:White},
I could call a good homeward wind...
But there are monsters about, so I
can't search for Kinstones.
And even if I could, I still can't
find anyone to fuse them with!
But you look pretty strong!

Do you think you could maybe search
for {Color:Red}Kinstones {Color:White}for me?
If you do, I'll tell you about a good
spot for {Color:Blue}fusing{Color:White}!
cz:
Wah! Lekl jsi me!

Obvykle obyvatele povrchu nedokazi
chodit po mracich jako my!
Sestra a ja jsme byli na {Color:Blue}Festivalu
Piccoru{Color:White} ve meste Hyrule,
a kdyz jsme se vraceli, vsude
byla monstra!
Kdybych spojil {Color:Red}Kamen osudu{Color:White}, mohl
bych privolat dobry vitr domu...
Ale vsude jsou monstra, takze
nemuzu hledat Kameny.
A i kdybych mohl, nemam s kym
je spojit!
Ale ty vypadas silny!

Myslis, ze bys mohl hledat
{Color:Red}Kameny osudu {Color:White}pro me?
Kdyz ano, reknu ti o dobrem
miste pro {Color:Blue}spojeni{Color:White}!

en:
Oh, this is bad. This is really bad...

Oh, hey! Wow... Look at that!

I've never seen a surface dweller walk
on clouds before!
You must be quite pure of heart!

Maybe one such as you would listen to
my tale of woe.
You see, I went down to the surface
with my sister for the {Color:Blue}Picori Festival{Color:White}...
But on our way home, we lost the wind
entirely! Now, we can't get home!
cz:
Ach, to je spatne. To je opravdu
spatne...
Ach, hej! Wow... Podivej!

Nikdy jsem nevidel obyvatele povrchu
chodit po mracich!
Musis mit cisteji srdce!

Mozna by mi takovy jako ty
poslechl muj smutny pribeh.
Vidis, sla jsem na povrch
se sestrou na {Color:Blue}Festival Piccoru{Color:White}...
Ale cestou domu jsme uplne
ztratili vitr! Ted nemuzeme domu!

en:
I hear that {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces {Color:White}are
sometimes hidden among the clouds!
cz:
Slysel jsem, ze {Color:Red}Kameny osudu {Color:White}
byvaji nekdy schovane v mracich!

en:
The {Color:Green}Picori Festival {Color:White}in Hyrule Town was
really fun and all...
But how unlucky to be stranded here,
unable to return home!
cz:
{Color:Green}Festival Piccoru {Color:White}v meste Hyrule
byl opravdu zabavny...
Ale jak smola tady uviznout,
bez moznosti dostat se domu!

en:
This is the home of the {Color:Green}Wind Tribe{Color:White}.
We left the surface long ago.
Now, we guard the entrance to the
{Color:Green}Palace of Winds{Color:White}...
...In this palace, the {Color:Red}Wind
Element {Color:White}resides.
But...that hole you just came out of...
Does that lead to the world below?
Oh, it appeared after you {Color:Blue}fused
Kinstones{Color:White}? That's amazing.
cz:
Toto je domov {Color:Green}Kmene vetru{Color:White}.
Davno jsme opustili povrch.
Ted strezime vchod do
{Color:Green}Palace vetru{Color:White}...
...V tom palaci sidli {Color:Red}Element
vetru{Color:White}.
Ale... ta dira, ze ktere jsi prisel...
Vede do sveta dole?
Ach, objevila se po {Color:Blue}spojeni
Kamenu osudu{Color:White}? To je uzasne.

en:
Oh, no! This is horrible!
My cuccos have gotten out!
Can you catch them for me?
{Choice:FF}I'll help! {Choice:30:03}No
cz:
Ach ne! To je hruza!
Ma kukka mi utekla!
Muzes mi je chytit?
{Choice:FF}Pomohu! {Choice:30:03}Ne

en:
Try to catch {Var:2} of them within
{Var:1} seconds, please.
And you can't go into buildings
or leave town!
cz:
Zkus chytit {Var:2} z nich za
{Var:1} sekund, prosim.
A nesmis chodit do budov
ani opustit mesto!

en:
Really? Come on,
why won't you help me?
cz:
Vazne? Ale ne,
proc mi nepomuzes?

en:
Time's up!
That's it!
cz:
Cas vyprsel!
A je to!

en:
Hmmm. Well, it looks like I'm still missing
a lot of cuccos...
But thanks anyway! Maybe you can
help out again another time.
cz:
Hmmm. No, zda se, ze mi porad
chybi spousta kukek...
Ale prece jen diky! Mozna mi
pomuzes zase priste.

en:
You have to catch {Var:2} cuccos
in {Var:1} seconds! Good luck!
cz:
Musis chytit {Var:2} kukek
za {Var:1} sekund! Hodne stesti!

en:
You got {Var:1} Rupees! Doesn't it
feel good to help others?
cz:
Dostal jsi {Var:1} rupii! Neni
fajn pomahat druhym?

en:
Thanks!
Here's your reward.
cz:
Diky!
Tady je tvoje odmena.

en:
What? What do you want? Why are
you bothering me, kid?
Huh? Oh, my name's Gorman. I'm trying

amazingly direct teaching style.
I wish I could train there...
cz:
{Color:Green}Swiftbladeova skola{Color:White} na jiznim
okraji mesta je vazne super.
Ucitel, {Color:Green}Swiftblade{Color:White}, ma uzasne
primy styl vyuky.
Rad bych tam trenoval...

en: Rrrrr...ARF ARF!
cz: Rrrrr...HAF HAF!

en: Arf arf arf!
cz: Haf haf haf!

en:
I'm sad that the festival's over.

Now that everyone's gone back to their
routines, it's boring around here.
cz:
Je mi smutno, ze festival skoncil.

Ted, kdyz se vsichni vratili ke
sve rutine, je tu nuda.

en:
You know, I got pretty far in last
year's tournament...
cz:
Vis, dostal jsem se docela daleko
v lonskem turnaji...

en: Meooow...
cz: Mnaaau...

en: Rowrrr!
cz: Vrrr!

en:
Buggedy-buggedy-BOO!

Did I scare ya?
cz:
Bagedy-bagedy-BU!

Vylekal jsem te?

en: Awww, man...
cz: Auuu, clovece...

en: Arr! Arf arf!
cz: Hrr! Haf haf!

en:
Not being anyone's pet sure does have
its perks...
I don't have to wait around for anyone
to feed me, for one thing.
cz:
Nebyt nicim mazlickem ma sve
vyhody...
Nemusim cekat, az mi nekdo da
zradlo, treba.

en:
What's that? You're looking for
something? Some kind of {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}?
cz:
Co to? Neco hledas? Nejakou
{Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}?

en:
The {Color:Green}king {Color:White}doesn't seem like himself
these days... It's weird.
cz:
{Color:Green}Kral {Color:White}v techto dnech neni
svuj... Je to divne.

en: Just what's up with the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}, anyway?
cz: Co je vlastne s tim {Color:Green}kralem{Color:White}?

en:
Man! I REALLY want to get in there
and play a few {Color:Blue}games{Color:White}...
I can't believe they're still closed!
I'm not going anywhere until they open!
cz:
Clovece! VAZNE chci jit dovnitr
a zahrat si par {Color:Blue}her{Color:White}...
Nemuzu uverit, ze maji porad zavreno!
Nikam nepujdu, dokud neotevrou!

en:
This stall is all dirty.

I guess the guy that usually sells his
stuff here isn't going to show...
cz:
Tenhle stanek je cely spinavy.

Asi se ten chlap, co tu obvykle
prodava, dnes neukaze...

en:
To tell you the truth, I'm sick of fruit,
and I just plain hate veggies!
cz:
Po pravde, ovoce uz nemuzu videt
a zelenina mi vyslovene vadi!

en:
Hey, hey! Come on up and take a look!
You're sure to see something you like!
cz:
Hej, hej! Pojdte se podivat!
Urcite najdete neco, co se vam libi!

en:
Come on up and get a good sniff!
Smelling's always free! Hey, hey!
cz:
Pojdte si poradne pricuchnout!
Cichani je vzdy zdarma! Hej, hej!

en:
Hey, hey! Come on up!
It's got beta-carotene, people!
It's good for your eyes!
cz:
Hej, hej! Pojdte!
Ma to beta-karoten, lidi!
Je to dobre na oci!

en:
You'll never get big and strong without
eating your greens! Hey, hey!
cz:
Nikdy nebudes velky a silny,
kdyz nebudes jist zeleninu! Hej, hej!

en:
I've never seen the {Color:Green}king {Color:White}like this!
He's so angry, so impatient!
I hear he's been just horrible
to the guards, too.
cz:
Nikdy jsem nevidel {Color:Green}krale {Color:White}takhle!
Je tak rozzlobeny, netrpelivy!
Slysel jsem, ze byl k strazim
uplne hrozny.

en:
Everyone in the castle is
on pins and needles!
cz:
Vsichni na hrade jsou jako
na trnech!

en:
I don't even know why I'm bothering to
look for that "{Color:Red}light force{Color:White}"...
I doubt anything that powerful
could possibly exist anyway.
cz:
Ani nevim, proc se obtezuji
hledat tu "{Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}"...
Pochybuji, ze by neco tak
mocneho vubec mohlo existovat.

en:
The inn's open for business now.

They're giving away a special gift
to everyone who stays there!
cz:
Hostinec je ted otevreny.

Davaji zvlastni darek kazdemu,
kdo se tam ubytuje!

en:
Of course there's no light force here!
What was I thinking? Stupid, stupid!
cz:
Samozrejme tu zadna svetelna sila
neni! Co jsem si myslel? Hloupy!

en:
We're in the middle of a very important
class right now, so I can't let you in.
cz:
Mame ted velmi dulezitou hodinu,
takze te nemuzu pustit dovnitr.

en:
Hello, {Player}. We are studying
Hyrulean Literature right now.
It's a very important subject!
cz:
Ahoj, {Player}. Prave studujeme
Hyrulskou literaturu.
Je to velmi dulezity predmet!

en:
The legend says that the {Color:Red}power of light{Color:White}
was given to humans by the {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}.
I wonder, does it really exist? I mean,
it's not like anyone's ever SEEN it.
cz:
Legenda rika, ze {Color:Red}moc svetla{Color:White}
byla lidem dana {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}.
Zajimalo by me, existuje vubec?
Nikdo ji prece nikdy NEVIDEL.

en:
There's an old legend that something
big will happen when Hyrule's bell rings.
cz:
Existuje stara legenda, ze se
stane neco velkeho, az se rozezni
zvon Hyrule.

en:
But nobody knows exactly
what will happen...
cz:
Ale nikdo presne nevi,
co se stane...

en:
I came here to check out a book.

They're supposed to be open by now.
I wonder what's going on...
cz:
Prisel jsem si pujcit knihu.

Uz by meli mit otevreno.
Co se to deje...

en:
Not like you'd know, but...do you think
it's safe to touch the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}?
With your bare hands, I mean... Do you
think maybe it burns or something?
cz:
Ne ze bys vedel, ale...myslis,
ze je bezpecne dotknout se
{Color:Red}svetelne sily{Color:White}? Holymi rukami...
Myslis, ze to pali nebo co?

en:
That little red thing is really
starting to bug me.
It's like a house or something.
cz:
Ta mala cervena vec me
zacina opravdu stvat.
Je jako dum nebo co.

en:
That little red thing is really
starting to bug me.
It's like a house or something.
cz:
Ta mala cervena vec me
zacina opravdu stvat.
Je jako dum nebo co.

en: Rrrr...ARF ARF!
cz: Rrrr...HAF HAF!

en: Arf arf arf!
cz: Haf haf haf!

en: Awoooooooo!!!
cz: Auvoooooo!!!

en:
Oh, sorry... Am I in your way?
I just wanted a little attention.
Anyway, it was nice of you to say hi.
Sorry for the trouble. I'll move now.
cz:
Ach, promin... Stojim ti v ceste?
Chtel jsem jen trochu pozornosti.
Bylo mile, ze ses pozdravil.
Promin za potize. Uz se posunu.

en: Everyone in this town is really nice.
cz:
Vsichni v tomto meste jsou
vazne mili.

en:
But really, why search for something
no one's ever seen before?
I mean, what does "{Color:Red}light force{Color:White}" look
like, anyway? The {Color:Green}king{Color:White}'s gone loopy.
cz:
Ale opravdu, proc hledat neco,
co nikdo nikdy nevidel?
Jak vlastne ta "{Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White}"
vypada? {Color:Green}Kral{Color:White} se zblaznil.

en:
I'm really quite good at tracking
down rare {Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}.
cz:
Jsem vazne docela dobry v
hledani vzacnych {Color:Red}figurek{Color:White}.

en:
I've collected so many! And not just the
normal ones. I've rare ones, too!
But don't even think about asking me
for 'em, because I ain't givin' you any!
cz:
Nasbiral jsem jich tolik! A nejen
bezne. Mam i vzacne!
Ale ani na me nemysli, ze bys
o nejake zadal, protoze ti je nedam!

en:
So, the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White} is some kind of
treasure that can grant any wish?
The {Color:Green}king {Color:White}must be looking for it so
that he can ensure peace in Hyrule.
cz:
Takze {Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White} je nejaky
poklad, co plni jakekoli prani?
{Color:Green}Kral {Color:White}ji asi hleda, aby zajistil
mir v Hyrule.

en:
Hey, you made it over, huh?

I bet crossing that narrow bridge
made you nervous, right?
cz:
Hej, dostal ses sem, vid?

Vsadim se, ze ten uzky most
te znervoznil, ze?

en:
Doesn't that hole over there
kind of bother you?
I wonder how to get over to it...
cz:
Nevadi ti ta dira tamhle?

Jak se k ni dostat...

en:
Ghosts are scary.

That one's nice, but even nice ghosts
are still scary. Aren't they?
cz:
Duchove jsou strasidelni.

Ten je mily, ale i mili duchove
jsou porad strasidelni. Vid?

en:
Thanks for coming.

Hardly anyone ever visits, and it gets
lonely here. Please take this.
cz:
Diky, ze jsi prisel.

Malokdo me navstevuje a je
tu samota. Prosim, vezmi si toto.

en:
The view from here is nice.

And Swiftblade's screams during
training seem to complement the scene.
cz:
Vyhled odtud je pekny.

A Swiftbladeovo krici pri treninku
scenu krasne doplnuje.

en:
Good job getting up here.
Really. That's impressive.
You must have really put yourself out
to find a way here. Please take this.
cz:
Dobre, ze ses dostal sem nahoru.
Vazne. To je obdivuhodne.
Musel ses opravdu snazit najit
cestu sem. Prosim, vezmi si toto.

en:
I wonder how I'm going to get down...
Those cucco chicks just terrify me.
cz:
Jak se dostanu dolu...
Ta kukci kurata me desi.

en:
You're always running around like
you've got some urgent business.
Why don't you just sit
a spell and relax?
cz:
Porad pobihas, jako bys mel
nejake nalehave zalezitosti.
Proc si proste chvili nesedis
a nerelaxujes?

en:
You're getting pretty tough,
aren't you, kid?
Bet you're still no match
for me, though...
cz:
Stavas se docela tvrdym,
vid, klucino?
Ale stejne se mi porad nevyrovnas...

en: Meooooow...
cz: Mnaaaau...

en: Rowrrr!
cz: Vrrr!

en:
Buggedy-buggedy-BOO!

Did I scare ya?
cz:
Bagedy-bagedy-BU!

Vylekal jsem te?

en:
Sigh. I guess my heart's just not in it.
Maybe I'm not cut out for this...
cz:
Povzdech. Asi to proste necitim.
Mozna na to nejsem stveny...

en: Arf! Arf arf!
cz: Haf! Haf haf!

en:
Haven't you ever wondered why I'm
always hanging out around here?
Well, you see...

I've been waiting to EAT you!

Just kidding.
Did I scare ya?
cz:
Neptal ses, proc se tu
porad poflakuji?
Vidis...

Cekal jsem, az te SNIM!

Jen si delam srandu.
Vylekal jsem te?

en:
I just can't find that {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}...
The {Color:Green}king {Color:White}is gonna be SO mad at me.
cz:
Nemuzu najit tu {Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}...
{Color:Green}Kral {Color:White}bude TAK rozzlobeny.

en:
I don't know... The {Color:Green}king{Color:White}'s mood
just keeps getting worse and worse.
cz:
Nevim... Naladu {Color:Green}krale{Color:White}
se porad zhorsuje a zhorsuje.

en:
I haven't seen {Color:Green}Princess Zelda {Color:White}in ages,
and the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}'s just plain loopy!
What's going on around here?
cz:
Nevidel jsem {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu {Color:White}veky,
a {Color:Green}kral{Color:White} se proste zblaznil!
Co se to tady deje?

en:
This stall is such a mess! Does that
mean Beedle's not going to show up?
cz:
Tenhle stanek je takovy neporadek!
Znamena to, ze Beedle neprijde?

en:
Don't they have anything other than
fruits and vegetables here?
cz:
Nemaji tady neco jineho nez
ovoce a zeleninu?

en:
Hey, hey!
Lookie, lookie!
cz:
Hej, hej!
Koukej, koukej!

en:
Hurry up and buy something,
or I smack you!
cz:
Pospes si a neco koup,
nebo te plesknu!

en:
Hey, hey! Cabbage and leeks, carrots
and eggplant! Get 'em all right here!
cz:
Hej, hej! Zeli a porek, mrkev
a lilek! Vsechno tady!

en:
Wha--? It's so small you can't
understand? Hey hey!
cz:
Co--? Je to tak male, ze tomu
nerozumis? Hej hej!

en:
What's going on with the {Color:Green}king {Color:White}lately?
He seems like...he's not himself...
cz:
Co je v poslednich dnech s {Color:Green}kralem{Color:White}?
Zda se, ze...neni svuj...

en:
That river sure is fishy!
I mean suspicious...
But I can't quite figure out why...
cz:
Ta reka je urcite rybi!
Myslim podezrela...
Ale nemuzu prijit na to proc...

en:
Hey, kid! Did you stay at the inn?
Well? And did you get your gift?
cz:
Hej, klucino! Byl jsi v hostinci?
No? A dostal jsi svuj darek?

en:
The {Color:Green}king {Color:White}hasn't made any public
appearances lately.
And with so many guards surrounding
the castle over the past few days...
nobody in town has a clue what's
going on in there!
cz:
{Color:Green}Kral {Color:White}se v poslednich dnech
verejne neobjevil.
A s tolika strazi kolem hradu
poslednich dnu...
nikdo ve meste netusi, co se
tam deje!

en:
We're having a VERY important class
right now, and I simply can't let you in!
cz:
Mame ted VELMI dulezitou hodinu
a proste te nemuzu pustit dovnitr!

en:
We're studying math right now, but once
we're done, that's it for the day!
cz:
Ucime se ted matematiku, ale
az skoncime, je dnesek za nami!

en:
I'm starting to think I won't find any
{Color:Red}light force {Color:White}near the castle.
cz:
Zacinam si myslet, ze u hradu
zadnou {Color:Red}svetelnou silu {Color:White}nenajdu.

en:
There's an old legend that something
big will happen when Hyrule's bell rings.
cz:
Existuje stara legenda, ze se
stane neco velkeho, az se rozezni
zvon Hyrule.

en:
I'm too scared to ring it myself, so I'm
hoping someone else will come along...
cz:
Sam ho mam strach rozeznit,
tak doufam, ze prijde nekdo jiny...

en:
Gah! Why won't someone hurry up and
find that stupid {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}!?
cz:
Gah! Proc uz konecne nekdo
nenajde tu hloupou {Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}!?

en:
Figures that the search for that "{Color:Red}light
force{Color:White}" isn't going too well...
I mean, that stuff never existed
in the first place!
I'm just disappointed in the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}. He
should have known better.
cz:
Hadalo se, ze hledani te "{Color:Red}svetelne
sily{Color:White}" nepujde dobre...
Vzdyt to nikdy ani neexistovalo!

Jsem zklamany {Color:Green}kralem{Color:White}. Mel by to
vedet lip.

en:
Figures that the search for that "{Color:Red}light
force{Color:White}" isn't going too well...
I mean, that stuff never existed
in the first place!
I'm just disappointed in the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}. He
should have known better.
cz:
Hadalo se, ze hledani te "{Color:Red}svetelne
sily{Color:White}" nepujde dobre...
Vzdyt to nikdy ani neexistovalo!

Jsem zklamany {Color:Green}kralem{Color:White}. Mel by to
vedet lip.

en: Rrrrr...ARF ARF!
cz: Rrrrr...HAF HAF!

en: Arf arf arf!
cz: Haf haf haf!

en: Awooooo!
cz: Auvoooo!

en:
Nobody even bothered to ask why I was
blocking the way for so long...
The people here are so polite, but they
lack backbone, you know what I mean?
cz:
Nikdo se ani neobtezoval zeptat,
proc tu blokuji cestu tak dlouho...
Lide jsou tu zdvorili, ale chybi
jim pater, vis jak to myslim?

en:
Maybe I can get this dog to go out and
search for the {Color:Red}light force {Color:White}for me...
Because I just can't take it anymore!
cz:
Mozna toho psa donutim, aby
sel hledat {Color:Red}svetelnou silu {Color:White}za me...
Uz to vazne nevydrzim!

en:
People are getting really crazy
about collecting those {Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}...
You probably don't know much about
that, though, do you?
cz:
Lide se opravdu zblaznili do
sbirani {Color:Red}figurek{Color:White}...
O tom asi moc nevis, vid?

en:
You know what? I don't even feel like
looking for that {Color:Red}light force {Color:White}anymore.
cz:
Vis co? Uz se mi ani nechce
hledat tu {Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}.

en:
Aww, gee. It looks like they're having
fun. I wish I could be in there...
cz:
Ach, jej. Vypada to, ze se bavi.
Keby si mohl byt s nimi...

en: I wanna play games, too!
cz: Taky si chci hrat hry!

en:
It looks like the simulation arcade is
open for business. Simon's here now.
cz:
Vypada to, ze simulacni arkada
je otevrena. Simon je tu.

en:
Nobody ever returns the books they
check out from the library.
cz:
Nikdo nikdy nevraci knihy, co si
pujci z knihovny.

en:
Don't they realize that other people
might want to read these books, too?
cz:
Neuvedomuji si, ze i jini lide
by si tyto knihy mohli chtit cist?

en:
I would love to have a figurine,
too, but they're too big for me...
cz:
Taky bych chtela figurku, ale
jsou pro me prilis velke...

en:
I want to dive into the fountain!
But I'm not such a good swimmer.
cz:
Chci se ponorit do fontany!
Ale nejsem dobry plavec.

en:
Ghosts are scary.
He seems like a funny ghost,
but ghosts are still scary.
Aren't they scary?
cz:
Duchove jsou strasidelni.
Vypada jako legracni duch, ale
duchove jsou porad strasidelni.
Nejsou strasidelni?

en:
Oooofff...
Ahh, it's no good.
I just can't get anywhere.
Man oh man oh man...
cz:
Uuuf...
Ach, nejde to.
Proste se nikam nedostanu.
Clovece, clovece, clovece...

en:
!!!!?

You made it?!
No way!!
cz:
!!!!?

Dokazal jsi to?!
To neni mozne!!

en:
Thanks for coming.

Hardly anyone ever visits, and it gets
lonely here. Please take this.
cz:
Diky, ze jsi prisel.

Malokdo me navstevuje a je
tu samota. Prosim, vezmi si toto.

en:
The view from here is nice.

And Swiftblade's screams during
training seem to complement the scene.
cz:
Vyhled odtud je pekny.

A Swiftbladeovo krici pri treninku
scenu krasne doplnuje.

en:
Good job getting up here.
Really. That's impressive.
You must have really put yourself out
to find a way here. Please take this.
cz:
Dobre, ze ses dostal sem nahoru.
Vazne. To je obdivuhodne.
Musel ses opravdu snazit najit
cestu sem. Prosim, vezmi si toto.

en:
I wonder how I'm going to get down...
Those cucco chicks just terrify me.
cz:
Jak se dostanu dolu...
Ta kukci kurata me desi.

en:
Lately, Mutoh's been grumbling about
how there's no work with any punch.
I wish I could do something about that,
but I don't even know what he means!
cz:
V poslednich dnech Mutoh bruci,
ze neni zadna prace s stavou.
Rad bych s tim neco udelal, ale
ani nevim, co tim mysli!

en:
I'm so glad the boss is back to his
usual self.
It just makes you grateful
for the good times, you know?
cz:
Jsem rada, ze sef je zase svuj.

Clovek je vdecny za dobre casy,
vis?

en:
I can hear those schoolkids laughing
all the way over here.
cz:
Slysim ty skolaky, jak se
smeji az sem.

en:
You know, even this headband can be
used as a weapon.
A real man has to be able to do battle
with whatever is at his disposal.
cz:
Vis, i tato celenka muze byt
pouzita jako zbran.
Opravdovy muz musi umet bojovat
stim, co ma po ruce.

en: Meoooow...
cz: Mnaaau...

en: Rowrrr!
cz: Vrrr!

en:
Buggedy-buggedy-BOO!

...Still nothin', huh?
cz:
Bagedy-bagedy-BU!

...Porad nic, huh?

en:
Yeah, I'm just about ready to hang up
my sheet and leave the ghost business.
cz:
Jo, uz jsem skoro pripraveny
povesit prosteradlo a opustit
ducharstvi.

en: Arf arf!
cz: Haf haf!

en:
I'm really good friends with that
dog on the other side of town.
We're nothing alike, but we still
get along really well.
cz:
Jsem opravdu dobry kamarad s
tim psem na druhe strane mesta.
Nejsme si vubec podobni, ale
stejne si dobre rozumime.

en: There's a ghost in the well...
cz: Ve studni je duch...

en: This water feels good...
cz: Ta voda je prijemna...

en: Is there really a ghost in the well?
cz: Je opravdu ve studni duch?

en:
I wonder what I should make for dinner
tonight? Hyrule stew maybe?
cz:
Co mam dnes vecer pripravit
k veceri? Mozna Hyrulskou polevku?

en:
Tch! This stall is such a mess!

Maybe that's why Beedle's not here
selling his Picolyte.
cz:
Tch! Tenhle stanek je neporadek!

Mozna proto tu Beedle
neprodava svuj Picolyte.

en: I wish we had a butcher...
cz: Keby tu byl reznik...

en: Hey, hey! Lowest prices anywhere!
cz: Hej, hej! Nejnizsi ceny vsude!

en:
Hurry up and buy, or I'll pelt you with
fruits! Hey, hey!
cz:
Pospes si a koup, nebo te
bombarduji ovocem! Hej, hej!

en:
Hey, hey! You buy, or
I don't let you leave!
cz:
Hej, hej! Bud koupis, nebo
te nepustim pryc!

en:
What is this! I haven't sold anything
all day! Hey, hey!
cz:
Co to je! Cely den jsem
nic neprodal! Hej, hej!

en:
I really don't feel like going back
to the castle for a while.
I'm scared, because people have said
there are monsters INSIDE the castle!
cz:
Opravdu se mi nechce zatim
vratit na hrad.
Mam strach, protoze lide rikaji,
ze jsou monstra UVNITR hradu!

en:
I just want to jump right in the river!
But it doesn't look like I can...
cz:
Chci skocit rovnou do reky!
Ale vypada to, ze nemuzu...

en: Kids are great, aren't they?
cz: Deti jsou skvele, ze?

en:
Only a few guards are still out there
looking for that {Color:Red}light force {Color:White}stuff.
cz:
Jen par strazi je porad venku
a hleda tu {Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}.

en:
There's an old legend that something
big will happen when Hyrule's bell rings.
cz:
Existuje stara legenda, ze se
stane neco velkeho, az se rozezni
zvon Hyrule.

en:
If nothing at all happens, does that
mean all the legends are just lies?
cz:
Kdyz se nestane nic, znamena to,
ze vsechny legendy jsou jen lzi?

en:
Figures that the search for that "{Color:Red}light
force{Color:White}" isn't going too well...
I mean, that stuff never existed
in the first place!
I'm just disappointed in the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}. He
should have known better.
cz:
Hadalo se, ze hledani te "{Color:Red}svetelne
sily{Color:White}" nepujde dobre...
Vzdyt to nikdy ani neexistovalo!

Jsem zklamany {Color:Green}kralem{Color:White}. Mel by to
vedet lip.

en: Rrrrr...ARF ARF!
cz: Rrrrr...HAF HAF!

en: Arf arf arf!
cz: Haf haf haf!

en: Awooooo!!!
cz: Auvoooo!!!

en:
I'm the best stray dog in town.

When it comes to begging for treats,
I know all the tricks!
cz:
Jsem nejlepsi zatoulany pes ve
meste.
Kdyz prijde na zebrani o pamlsky,
znam vsechny triky!

en:
Each of those figurines is handmade.
Yup! Each and every one of 'em!
I bet you have no idea how much
they're worth. Hehehehe...
cz:
Kazda z tech figurek je rucni prace.
Jo! Kazda jedna z nich!
Vsadim se, ze netusis, kolik
stoji. Hehehehe...

en:
There are fewer and fewer guards
out here with each passing day...
Where do you think they've all gone?
cz:
Stale mene strazi je venku
kazdy dalsi den...
Kam asi vsichni odesli?

en:
I keep wondering how you get to the
rooftop deck at the Happy Hearth Inn.
There's got to be a way. Have you
been up there yet?
cz:
Porad premyslim, jak se dostat
na terasu hostince Happy Hearth.
Musi byt cesta. Byl jsi uz tam
nahoru?

en:
Not only am I a collector of figurines,
but I'm also rich! Filthy, stinkin' rich!
cz:
Jsem nejen sberatel figurek,
ale jsem i bohaty! Hodne bohaty!

en:
If you ever find a complete set of
{Color:Green}figurines{Color:White}, you should tell me.
You...do know what I'm talking about,
don't you? Well? Get to it!
cz:
Kdyz najdes kompletni sadu
{Color:Green}figurek{Color:White}, mel bys mi to rict.
Vis o cem mluvim, ze? Tak?
Dej se do toho!

en:
!?

Whooooooooooooaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!

You did it! I can't believe you did it!
This is...a totally complete set!
How incredibly awesome! And you even
got the legendary Carlov Medal!!! 
It shines with a beautiful light...
It's every collector's dream!
What you've shown me here... It's
just... It's just amazing.
Here, feel free to go in my house and
take whatever you want in thanks...
'Cuz, you know, I'm rich! Hahaha!
cz:
!?

Uuuuuuaaaaaaaaa!!!!

Dokazals to! Nemuzu uverit,
ze ses to dokazal!
Toto je... uplne kompletni sada!
Neuveritelne uzasne! A dostals
dokonce legendarni Carlovovu medaili!!! 
Zari krasnym svetlem...
Je to sen kazdeho sberatele!
Co jsi mi tady ukazal... Je to
proste... uzasne.
Tady, klidne jdi do meho domu a
vezmi si cokoli chces jako diky...
Protoze, vis, jsem bohaty! Hahaha!

en:
Way to go, man.
What an awesome day...
cz:
Tak ses to dokazal, clovece.
Jaky uzasny den...

en:
When I run, the thing that I'm eating
always falls out of my mouth.
cz:
Kdyz bezim, to co jim mi vzdy
vypadne z huby.

en: Yaaay! Yaaaay!
cz: Hurraa! Hurraaa!

en: I'm planting my flower bed.
cz: Sazim si zahon.

en: You've got to water these every day.
cz: Tyhle musis kazdy den zalevat.

en:
It's OK to collect figurines, but if
anyone starts calling 'em dolls, well...
That would just be bad.
cz:
Sbirat figurky je OK, ale
kdyz jim nekdo zacne rikat
panenky, no... To by bylo spatne.

en:
I wonder if the force looks
really big to Picori...
cz:
Zajimalo by me, jestli ta sila
vypada pro Picori opravdu velka...

en:
That dog over there's not very friendly
to strangers, but I like that in a dog.
cz:
Ten pes tamhle neni moc pratelsky
k cizincum, ale to se mi na psu libi.

en:
Good work getting here! I don't get
many visitors, as you can imagine.
cz:
Dobre, ze ses sem dostal! Nemam
moc navstev, jak si umis predstavit.

en:
Whoa! You made it here really quickly!
You're full of surprises, aren't you?
cz:
Whoa! Dostal ses sem velmi rychle!
Jsi plny prekvapeni, ze?

en:
Thanks for coming.

Hardly anyone ever visits, and it gets
lonely here. Please take this.
cz:
Diky, ze jsi prisel.

Malokdo me navstevuje a je
tu samota. Prosim, vezmi si toto.

en:
The view from here is nice.

And Swiftblade's screams during
training seem to complement the scene.
cz:
Vyhled odtud je pekny.

A Swiftbladeovo krici pri treninku
scenu krasne doplnuje.

en:
Good job getting up here.
Really. That's impressive.
You must have really put yourself out
to find a way here. Please take this.
cz:
Dobre, ze ses dostal sem nahoru.
Vazne. To je obdivuhodne.
Musel ses opravdu snazit najit
cestu sem. Prosim, vezmi si toto.

en:
I wonder how I'm going to get down...
Those cucco chicks just terrify me.
cz:
Jak se dostanu dolu...
Ta kukci kurata me desi.

en:
Lately, Mutoh's been grumbling about
how there's no work with any punch.
I wish I could do something about that,
but I don't even know what he means!
cz:
V poslednich dnech Mutoh bruci,
ze neni zadna prace s stavou.
Rad bych s tim neco udelal, ale
ani nevim, co tim mysli!

en:
I'm so glad the boss is back to his
usual self.
It just makes you grateful
for the good times, you know?
cz:
Jsem rada, ze sef je zase svuj.

Clovek je vdecny za dobre casy,
vis?

en:
So you've actually seen
the inside of {Color:Green}Anju's henhouse{Color:White}?
Hehehehe...
cz:
Takze ses opravdu podival
dovnitr {Color:Green}Anjuina kurniku{Color:White}?
Hehehehe...

en:
Each town has its own life, its
own rhythm! You know what I mean?
I love towns with lots of rhythm! But
it has to keep up the pace!
cz:
Kazde mesto ma svuj zivot,
svuj rytmus! Vis jak to myslim?
Miluji mesta s velkym rytmem!
Ale musi drzet tempo!

en: Meoooow...
cz: Mnaaau...

en: Rowrrr!
cz: Vrrr!

en:
Buggedy-buggedy-BOO!

...So, umm... Yeah. Anyway.
cz:
Bagedy-bagedy-BU!

...Tak, ehm... Jo. Mejvyborne.

en:
Wait a minute... I see now! You're so
scared, you can hardly speak!
cz:
Pockej... Ted to chapu! Mas
takovy strach, ze sotva mluvis!

en: Arf arf!
cz: Haf haf!

en:
I must look like a huge oversized
monster to you right now, huh?
Just be grateful I don't EAT you,
pip-squeak.
cz:
Asi ti pripadam jako obrovske
monstrum, vid?
Bud rad, ze te NESNIM,
trpasliku.

en: You can see everything from up here...
cz: Odtud nahoru je videt vsecko...

en: Ah... This is great.
cz: Ach... To je skvele.

en: I love being a kid...
cz: Miluji byt ditetem...

en:
So, what'll it be tonight? We haven't
had Tektite souffle in ages...
cz:
Co bude dnes vecer? Uz jsme
veky nemeli Tektitove sufle...

en:
Tch! Would you look at this mess?

I'm sure Beedle could use this spot to
sell Picolyte if it weren't such a pigsty.
cz:
Tch! Podivej na ten neporadek!

Beedle by tu mohl prodavat Picolyte,
keby to nebyl takovy chliv.

en:
Come on now, hurry up and figure out
what you're going to buy already!
cz:
No tak, pospes si a uz se
rozhodni, co si koupis!

en:
Hey, hey! Veggies makes the ideal gift,
perfect for all occasions!
cz:
Hej, hej! Zelenina je idealni darek,
perfektni pro vsechny prilezitosti!

en:
Send a few of these as a gift, and
make me a happy, happy woman!
Hey, hey!
cz:
Posli par techle jako darek
a udelas ze me stastnou zenu!
Hej, hej!

en:
Hey, hey! The other vendor's not doing
so hot, but neither am I!
cz:
Hej, hej! Druhemu prodavaci to
nejde, ale ani me!

en:
My arm's getting tired, so buy, buy,
buy! Hey, hey!
cz:
Ruka me boli, tak kup, kup,
kup! Hej, hej!

en:
Maybe I should get back
to the castle soon...
cz:
Mozna bych se mel brzy
vratit na hrad...

en:
I give up. There's no {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}
out here. Man, am I tired.
cz:
Vzdavam to. Zadna {Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White}
tu neni. Clovece, jsem unaveny.

en:
Kids are really the most wonderful
things ever.
cz:
Deti jsou opravdu ta nejkrasnejsi
vec, co existuje.

en:
There are a lot fewer guards looking
for the {Color:Red}light force {Color:White}now...
cz:
Stale mene strazi hleda
{Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}...

en:
There's an old legend that something
big will happen when Hyrule's bell rings.
cz:
Existuje stara legenda, ze se
stane neco velkeho, az se rozezni
zvon Hyrule.

en:
That time may be coming soon...
I can just feel it.
cz:
Ten cas asi prijde brzy...
Proste to citim.

en:
It's tough work, being the {Color:Green}mailman{Color:White}.
Look at him, always runnin' around!
cz:
Je to tezka prace byt {Color:Green}postak{Color:White}.
Podivej na nej, porad pobiha!

en: Rrrrr...ARF ARF!
cz: Rrrrr...HAF HAF!
